channels_gloss: A box's "role" is just the set of channels it runs. Self-asserted channels turn on with one click; governed channels are requested, then approved by the dual-meter.
cli_gloss: Everything on this console is also a command. These are the operator-plane verbs the console wraps.
coaffected_peer_none: No co-affected peers — Meter C auto-passes.
consent_leg.operator: No government is seated for this scope yet — consent runs through Meter A, the operator board.
consent_leg.seated: A government is seated for this scope — Meter B holds consent, and the operator board can no longer attest on its behalf.
